candidates.title: Voice transcription and translation for Mac users

demandEvidence.chore: Turn spoken words into text in a Mac app and type a translated version into another app.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Whistle Translator turns your voice into text in any app on your Mac, and can type it in another language.

ease.reason: A synthetic audio-to-text demo is imaginable, but the source documents no implementation method or supplied building reference.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: multilingual professionals might pay for this convenience; this product description establishes neither customer demand nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock could test short supplied clips, but cross-app input, transcription quality and translation remain unsupported.

autonomy.reason: A proposed clip-to-translation loop is conceivable, but no implementation support is attached and a person must check meaning before use.

evidence.reason: The excerpt describes voice transcription and translated typing, but provides no task frequency, workflow detail or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow synthetic audio-to-translation experiment from the described task. Provisional mean 18/5 = 3.6, below 6; this single product description supplies no repeated external demand, payer evidence or implementation reference.
